facts.text: Jake's paying for dinner, he just doesn't know it yet. Order whatever you like, and keep the car running out the front.
facts.why: At the Soul Food Cafe, Elwood asks for dry white toast and Jake orders four fried chickens and a Coke. No scheme to stick Jake with the bill is shown in any source opened.
facts.fix: Four fried chickens and a Coke for Jake, dry white toast for me. Keep the Bluesmobile running out the front.

vibe.verdict: Strong late-night diner look, but the food skips the film's best-known order and leans on invented jokes.
